title: Admit a same-path predecessor-generation registered check when the named root was only recovered or renamed and its source is unchanged
outcome: When a held claim's named root keeps the same canonical path but moved to a newer generation through claim-lapse recovery or renaming, and the source is unchanged against the host-acknowledged original verification body, termal_evaluate_acceptance admits the original registered check instead of refusing with registered_check_root_rebound. Every other root_rebound protection is unchanged.
acceptance: A behavioural test drives the real evaluation request and spawn path. A live held requester with the same authority store, work, run, root execution and claim identity and a monotonic recovery fence, the same canonical workspace path, a strictly older registration generation, and a complete current owner SourceId unchanged against the host-acknowledged original verification body is ADMITTED. The historical registration is neither mutated nor relabelled, and no new credit is granted.
file:line for the new admission lane in acceptance_committed_input.rs. The change has a clean review pair and passes the full gate.
